summary.scope: Fixed-pool Bayesian compatibility experiment, no learned/calibrated probabilities. Teacher connectivity audited only after all choices.
summary.dependence: Within-family averaging avoids per-check multiplication. Approximate conditional independence between family summary channels is an explicit supplied assumption.
summary.deduplication: Identical connectivity and role placement up to a common positive repeat scale share one model. Repeated proposal routes gain no prior mass.
summary.training: No fitting in this round. Future generated examples require recipe/family-held-out train/validation/test splits, likelihood calibration and separate proposal-coverage evaluation.
